verdict.rationale: Svelte's official GitHub repo directs users to "stop by the Discord chatroom", and svelte.dev invites developers to "join us in our Discord server" alongside the Svelte Society, so an official community chatroom clearly exists. The evidence does not show that it is a help or support channel, how it is organized, or that the community there is active. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Discord is a place to get help or support, details of channels or structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration of community activity and helpfulness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can join an official community chatroom to get help and connect with other framework users

citations.quote: Find your chapter and join us in our Discord server.
